what: The path the cursor travels stays as an ink line for 900ms. A node is stamped only when the cursor moves more than 2px, and the width thins from 3.2 to .9px according to speed (px/ms ÷ 2.4), following the previous node by .35 each step. Each node uses its remaining life s for opacity 1−s² and width ×(.55 + .45·opacity), so the tail gets thinner and fainter. Nodes are joined by quadratic curves through their midpoints. As a white line with difference blending, it looks black on light backgrounds and white over dark photos.
note: Not attached on touch or reduced motion
